summary: Frontend-only regression test of PaypalCheckout after innerHTML='' -> replaceChildren() change. Pricing modal opens (topup-btn -> pricing-modal), PayPal tab renders paypal-panel (GET /api/paypal/config returns enabled:true, mode:live). PACKS sub-tab: capRef container [data-testid=paypal-buttons] populated by PayPal SDK (2 iframes, ~17.2KB HTML, gold PayPal + Debit/Credit Card buttons visible). ABBONAMENTI sub-tab: subRef container [data-testid=paypal-sub-buttons] populated (2 iframes, Subscribe + PayPal Credit Subscribe + card buttons). Toggled packs<->subs 3 times: no JS errors, containers re-mount cleanly (no duplicate/stale buttons). Stripe tab regression OK: 6 buy-* buttons across 3 packs + 3 subscriptions. No payment was completed.
critical_code_review_comments: replaceChildren() is functionally equivalent to innerHTML='' here; combined with b.close() cleanup it prevents duplicate button mounts - verified with repeated tab toggling (3 round trips).

Console noise (non-blocking, NOT caused by this change): two 'Failed to load resource: 401' entries during page load, and a React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' coming from the Emergent preview visual-editor instrumentation injected into the <option> of the paypal-pkg select (App.js ~1469). Neither breaks PayPal mounting.
PayPal config reports mode:'live' in the preview environment - confirm intended (sandbox warning banner therefore hidden; risk of real payments during manual testing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayPal is ENABLED (live) in preview, so both sub-tab containers render real PayPal iframes. Selectors: topup-btn, pricing-modal, tab-stripe/tab-paypal, pp-mode-packs/pp-mode-subs, paypal-buttons (capRef), paypal-sub-buttons (subRef), buy-* for Stripe. Do NOT click PayPal iframe buttons (live mode).
rca_of_the_issue: No regression found; replaceChildren() empties the container before window.paypal(.Sub).Buttons(...).render() exactly as innerHTML='' did.
